Measure on the plate: head count per view, limb lengths per view as ratios of height, scale agreement between views (reject above 5 % and regenerate once naming the drift), contour weight in px against 1/120 of figure height ± 20 %, taper and closure (C22). Lay the sheet and its measurements into the `ModelSheet` composition and render one still. Write `assets/<character>/model.json` (views, heads, limb ratios, contour weight, sha256 of the plate, the generation receipt). Cut nothing here. Do not pick: the owner approves the sheet from the still, and until then it is provisional.

Measure on the plate: head count per view, limb lengths per view as ratios of height, scale agreement between views (reject above 5 % and regenerate once naming the drift), contour weight in px (D76: on the first sheet of a character, record the measured line as the character's standard in model.json `contour.ratio`; on a later sheet, compare to it ± 20 % at the same figure height), taper and closure (C22). Lay the sheet and its measurements into the `ModelSheet` composition and render one still. Write `assets/<character>/model.json` (views, heads, limb ratios, contour weight, sha256 of the plate, the generation receipt). Cut nothing here. Do not pick: the owner approves the sheet from the still, and until then it is provisional.
 
 Return: Views (cell, measured heads and ratios); Scale Agreement; Clean-up Measured; Sheet Path; model.json Path; Generation Receipt; Rejected Generations; Concerns.
\ No newline at end of file

```
